## About This Guide

Jiongeze was created to help learners move from knowledge to opportunity through practical learning, creativity, community participation, and small real-world activities.

The guide combines:

* Learning
* Observation
* Communication
* Community engagement
* Practice
* Reflection

The goal is not only to learn information.

The goal is to create meaningful action.



::: {.callout-note}
Learning becomes stronger when knowledge is used.
:::

## Learning Principles

Jiongeze follows a simple approach:

### Learn

Build understanding.

### Practice

Apply what you learn.

### Create

Develop ideas and projects.

### Contribute

Help communities and others.

### Grow

Continue improving.

## Learning Cycle

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR

A[Learn]

A --> B[Practice]

B --> C[Create]

C --> D[Contribute]

D --> E[Grow]

E --> A
```

Learning continues throughout life.

## Notes for Learners

Remember:

✓ Start with small steps

✓ Practice regularly

✓ Ask questions

✓ Work with others

✓ Learn from mistakes

✓ Continue improving
